about: Measured values of the submitted manuscript of a published article (read in the preprint on SSRN; the published version was not opened), in the format of thermoml_<id>.json. Purity 0.989 (mole fraction, supplier's certificate; Sigma-Aldrich). Critical temperature and pressure by the pulse-heating method, with the expanded uncertainties printed in Tables 2 and 3 (95 % confidence); the authors' acentric factor, 0.419 (Table 3), is for comparison only. Heat capacity: DSC, the smoothed values of Table 5 (fitted range 298.14-451.14 K), U_r = 3 % (95 %). Thermal conductivity: computed by the authors from their measured thermal diffusivity, their heat capacity and literature densities, the smoothed values of Table 7, U_r = 8 % (95 %). The normal boiling temperature of Table 2 is the average of earlier articles, not measured here.

source.citation: E.D. Nikitin, A.P. Popov, N.S. Bogatishcheva, M.Z. Faizullin, Measurement of the critical temperatures, pressures, heat capacities, and thermal diffusivities of four furanic compounds involved in the production of second-generation biofuels, Fluid Phase Equilib. 565 (2023) 113656
source.access: the authors' submitted manuscript (preprint, not peer reviewed), free to read on SSRN (doi:10.2139/ssrn.4213180); the numbers were read in that copy, not in the published article
source.tables: Table 2 (Tc), Table 3 (pc, omega), Table 5 (smoothed Cp,m), Table 7 (smoothed thermal conductivities)
